# Set Slow Motion

Source: [wiki article 4435](../archive/4435.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Set Slow Motion](../../api/actions/set-slow-motion.md).

<a id="wiki-4435-n1"></a>

- Slow Motion changes simulation rate for players, projectiles, effects and game-mode logic; only rates up to 100% are allowed.
